# Final Wave Two Write Plan — Paid Action Covenant

The Awtsmoos is beyond transaction and time; Awtsmoos.com must nevertheless make every finite paid action reversible until value is proven.

## Exact New Files
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/productCreditReservationValidation.js`
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/productCreditReservationStore.js`
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/productCreditReservationTransitions.js`
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/productCreditReservationService.js`
- `api/wallet/routes/commerceCreditReservationResponse.js`
- `api/wallet/routes/commerceCreditReserve.js`
- `api/wallet/routes/commerceCreditCommit.js`
- `api/wallet/routes/commerceCreditRelease.js`
- `api/wallet/tests/productCreditReservations.test.js`
- `api/wallet/tests/productCreditReservationRoutes.test.js`
- `shared/commerce/paidActionClient.js`
- `shared/commerce/PaidActionCoordinator.js`

## Existing Whole-File Rewrite
- `api/wallet/routes/table.js` only: preserve all current routes, add reserve/commit/release doorways, exact required header/JSDoc/tab format.

## State Invariants
1. Reserve deducts available balance under the existing Wallet file lock.
2. Reserve never increments `lifetimeConsumed`.
3. Commit never deducts again; it increments lifetime consumption exactly once.
4. Release restores exactly the reserved amount exactly once.
5. Same reservation key + same testimony deduplicates.
6. Same reservation key + different testimony conflicts.
7. Commit after release conflicts; release after commit conflicts.
8. Expired reservations become releasable and cannot later charge unexpectedly.
9. Existing direct `consume` remains unchanged for immediate deterministic actions.
10. Reservation transaction rows use reservation-specific keys so direct-consume idempotency is never polluted.

## Browser Covenant
- Client can request a reservation but cannot turn it into provider fulfillment by itself.
- Coordinator reserves before asynchronous paid work, commits only after `execute()` resolves successfully, and releases on error/cancellation.
- User-key or free paths can bypass the coordinator entirely.
- Product-specific server code remains responsible for authoritative unit/capability pricing before this pattern is adopted for real provider-backed work.

## Verification
- Full readback all written files.
- `node --check` all JS files.
- exact 3-line header check.
- tab-only indentation check.
- <120 line check.
- existing 9 commerce tests plus new reservation tests.
- concurrency test: two reservations cannot overdraw the same account/product balance.
- idempotency test: retries never double reserve/commit/release.
